name: 11225 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11225 (Brooklyn) has 300 nonprofit organizations. 83 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11225 (Brooklyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
